content.short: A sexy native Cardano Token, with a plan to change the world!
content.description:
BeardCoin(BDC) is a Cardano-Based coin that started as a joke. As time went on, we found that there's not much funny about it as it has a real use case. The goal now behind BDC is to become the preferred method of payment for barbershops, salons, hairdressers, and independent beauticians alike, all through the Cardano Blockchain.

Cardano is an open platform that seeks to provide economic identity to the billions who lack it by providing decentralized applications to manage identity, value, and governance, so those ridiculous gas fees go right back in your pocket; Or maybe even an extra tip for a job well done!

"One Beard Today, A Million Tomorrow!"
